messages:
marie: Quick thread — contractor Kavita Patel (starts Mon) needs I-9 verification, background-check intake completed, day-1 badging and laptop. Can we confirm who owns each step?
alex chen: I can own day-1 orientation and desk intro. For I-9, do we require in-person? Kavita is hybrid SF.
samir (IT Ops): I-9 is people-ops. For laptop, I can provision. Which device? also need shipping address if not picking up.
marie: Thanks. I-9: must be completed on or before first day. We can do remote review + in-person or verify in office on Day 1. Accepted docs (short): `Passport` OR `Driver's License + Social Security card` OR `State ID + Birth Cert` — please confirm what Kavita can bring.
lena (People Ops): FYI contractors usually do remote I-9 review + come by for badge pickup if local. If remote only, we do a video review + hold badge for pickup later.
alex chen: Kavita confirmed she has Passport and will be in SF on Day 1. So passport alone covers I-9, good.
marie: Perfect — action items: 1) Marie sends e-sign forms and BG intake link; 2) Samir creates hw ticket; 3) Alex coordinates 1:1 schedule and badge time.
marie: E-sign links: https://redwood-hr.example.com/esign/XXXX (BG intake link posted there). Please complete BG intake by Fri 5pm. I'll push an auto-reminder.
samir (IT Ops): For device — requesting MacBook Air M2 16GB unless manager specifies. Shipping or pick up? If pick up, Ops desk is 3rd floor, 9am-5pm. If shipping, drop address in this thread.
alex chen: We'll have Kavita pick up at 10am. Also will send calendar invite for 10:30 walkthru.
marie: Badge pickup flow: stop by Ops desk (3rd floor) with passport, show to desk — they'll print and activate badge in ~10 mins. If anything blocked, call ops ext 1400.
alex chen: One more Q — benefits eligibility for contractors? Kavita is 6-month contract.
lena (People Ops): Contractors <12 months are not eligible for full benefits. We do offer voluntary commuter and optional short-term insurance — I can DM Kavita the enrollment link if she wants.
onboarding-bot: Reminder scheduled: BG-intake reminder -> Fri 17:00 UTC.
marie: Samir, please confirm hw ticket number once created. Alex, can you confirm Kavita's preferred pickup time here?
samir (IT Ops): HW ticket #HW-1987 created, ETA provisioning 2 business days. Will have device ready at Ops desk by Mon 9:30.
alex chen: Confirmed — Kavita will pick up at 9:30 and we have 10:30 intro with team. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
marie: Closing loop — I'll send final Day 0 checklist to Kavita and cc you all. If anything changes ping me here.
alex chen: Sounds good, thanks!
